name: Visual Query Builder
description: Build read-only SELECT queries visually in DBX: draggable relationship diagram, foreign-key auto-join, live SQL preview, and CSV/XLSX/PDF export.
releaseNotes: First release. Draggable relationship diagram with real foreign keys and 1/N cardinality, automatic LEFT JOIN from foreign-key metadata, live SQL preview with an optional manual editor, read-only execution through the DBX Host API, result grid with global and per-column filters plus paging and column resizing, and export to CSV, .xlsx, PDF, and a printable HTML document.
